description.zh: 记录一次运行：所属研究方案、状态、代码仓库与提交、数据集与版本、检查点、配置、环境、种子、评估集合、起止时间、观测指标、结果（单次或汇总，汇总注明来源运行、方法、样本数与离散度）、日志产物、失败原因与备注。列表按状态筛选，也能搜索、归档与移入回收站；详情直接编辑并在输入时自动存草稿，修订冲突可以载入最新记录；可以把一条运行复制成计划中的新运行，不复制状态、观测值、时间与产物。这里只记录，不执行任何脚本。
description.en: Records a run: its research plan, status, code repository and commit, datasets with splits and versions, checkpoints, configuration, environment, seeds, evaluation set, start and end times, observed metrics, results (single or aggregate with source runs, method, sample size and dispersion), log artifacts, failure reason and notes. The list filters by status, also searches, archives and trashes; the detail edits in place, keeps a draft while you type, keeps your input when saving fails, and offers the latest record on a revision conflict. A run can be duplicated as a planned run without copying status, observations, times or artifacts. Nothing is executed here.

search.zh: 搜索标题、方案、环境与结果
search.en: Search titles, plans, environments and results

emptyActive.zh: 还没有运行记录；点「新建」记下一次运行。
emptyActive.en: No run records yet; use New to record a run.

emptyTrash.zh: 回收站是空的。移入回收站的记录三十天后自动清除。
emptyTrash.en: The trash is empty. Trashed records are cleared after thirty days.

truncated.zh: 只列出最近 {n} 条，共 {total} 条；用搜索找更早的记录。
truncated.en: Showing the latest {n} of {total}; search for older records.

quotaWarning.zh: 记录已用到 {percent}%，先整理归档或回收站。
quotaWarning.en: Records use {percent}% of the limit; tidy the archive or trash.

planNoneHint.zh: 只列出活跃与归档的研究记录；方案缺失时保留原 id，可以重新选。
planNoneHint.en: Lists active and archived research notes; a missing plan keeps its id so you can reselect it.

codeHint.zh: 仓库写地址，提交写哈希或标记；只是记录，不拉取代码。
codeHint.en: Repository as an address, commit as a hash or tag; recorded only, nothing is fetched.

datasetInvalid.zh: 数据集要有名称；整行留空会丢掉。
datasetInvalid.en: Datasets need a name; entirely empty rows are dropped.

entriesHint.zh: 指标保持名称、数值、单位与定义；值可以写文字，零与未给出分开记录。
entriesHint.en: Metrics keep name, value, unit and definition; values may be text, and zero stays distinct from missing.

entryInvalid.zh: 条目要同时有名称和数值；整行留空会丢掉。
entryInvalid.en: Entries need both a name and a value; entirely empty rows are dropped.

environmentHint.zh: 例如机器、工具链版本与依赖；留空时列表显示未知。
environmentHint.en: For example machine, toolchain versions and dependencies; an empty field shows as unknown.

seedHint.zh: 一组或多组种子，原样记录；留空时列表显示未知。
seedHint.en: One or more seeds, recorded as written; an empty field shows as unknown.

evaluationHint.zh: 例如测试集名称、阈值校准集合与评估集合的划分。
evaluationHint.en: For example test set names, or how calibration and evaluation sets differ.

timeHint.zh: 时间允许未知；成功也不要求补造时间。
timeHint.en: Times may be unknown; a successful run does not need invented times.

timeInvalid.zh: 时间要是可识别的写法，例如 2026-11-15T08:00。
timeInvalid.en: Times must be recognizable, for example 2026-11-15T08:00.

resultManual.zh: 手工汇总（没有可引用的来源运行）

resultSourcesHint.zh: 汇总要选来源运行，或显式标记手工汇总；不编造种子。
resultSourcesHint.en: Aggregates pick source runs or are explicitly marked manual; seeds are never invented.

resultInvalid.zh: 每条结果要有内容；汇总没有来源运行时要标记手工汇总。
resultInvalid.en: Every result needs text; an aggregate without source runs must be marked manual.

artifactInvalid.zh: 产物地址只收 http/https 的完整地址，说明不能为空。
artifactInvalid.en: Artifact links must be complete http/https addresses with a title.

failureHint.zh: 失败与负结果照常归档检索，不因为结果不好而改写状态。
failureHint.en: Failures and negative results stay searchable; a bad outcome does not rewrite the status.

duplicateHint.zh: 复制方案、代码、数据集、检查点、配置、环境与种子；不复制状态、指标、结果、时间与产物。
duplicateHint.en: Copies plan, code, datasets, checkpoints, configuration, environment and seeds; status, metrics, results, times and artifacts are not copied.

duplicated.zh: 已复制为一条计划中的运行。

draftRestored.zh: 已恢复上次未保存的内容。

unsavedClose.zh: 还有没保存的修改；关闭后草稿会保留。
unsavedClose.en: There are unsaved changes; closing keeps the draft.

conflict.zh: 这条记录在别处更新过，保存被拒绝。可以载入最新的内容，或继续用你的编辑。
conflict.en: This record changed elsewhere and the save was rejected. Load the latest content, or continue with your edits.

loadLatest.zh: 载入最新（放弃本地修改）

trashRestoreHint.zh: 回收站里的记录三十天后自动清除；先恢复再编辑。
trashRestoreHint.en: Trashed records are cleared after thirty days; restore before editing.
